mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO agent_task_step (tenant_id, task_id, step_no, step_name, step_type, tool_name, agent_role, input_params, `output`, status, error_msg, retry_count, deleted) VALUES
(#{s.tenantId}, #{s.taskId}, #{s.stepNo}, #{s.stepName}, #{s.stepType}, #{s.toolName}, #{s.agentRole}, #{s.inputParams,typeHandler=com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.handlers.JacksonTypeHandler}, #{s.output,typeHandler=com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.handlers.JacksonTypeHandler}, #{s.status}, #{s.errorMsg}, #{s.retryCount}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_task_step SET deleted = id, updated_at = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT step_type AS stepType, IFNULL(tool_name, '') AS toolName, IFNULL(agent_role, '') AS agentRole, AVG(duration_ms) AS avgMs, COUNT(*) AS samples FROM agent_task_step WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'SUCCESS' AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND created_at >= #{since} GROUP BY step_type, IFNULL(tool_name, ''), IFNULL(agent_role, '')
